Same natural photographic faces, fine skin/hair texture, same poses and shared home-game mood. Preserve exactly the original navy living room, blue evening window left, amber floor lamp, bookcase/globe/plants right, couch and orange cushions; rich warm wood. Preserve tiny green square mascot on shelf and orange shield with turquoise tie/cyan keyhole peeking behind couch on right. Blue cloud-headed screen-faced Piko in suit beside phone. Realism: not a painting/cartoon people. Mini mascots belong naturally to the room with contact shadows.
Keep one physical ivory blank printed-page plane on wooden table between family and camera, oriented toward the family. It is genuinely on the wood, with the ochre orange marker diagonally overlapping its lower right corner and one/two pens nearby. Keep ONE SMALL realistic phone close to family, to paper's right; black blank glass with soft reflection; no interface/text. Dad points at paper near its upper edge. Page and phone are BLANK for insertion of approved original game content later. It is very important to keep the game-sized physical page and phone high enough in the canvas, and to optically zoom out the whole photographed arrangement rather than fill the frame with giant foreground paper.
Keep subject/paper/phone identity and relative arrangement. No lettering, captions, logo, button, watermark, QR, new objects/people/characters. No artificial padding, borders, inset frames, empty color strips or blurry bands. Natural full-bleed photography right to all edges, with room above and tabletop below. Composition planning is intentional for native editable text added later; text itself MUST NOT appear.
